prompt.zh-TW: 月光書店的資產負債表要把科目分成「一年內會變成現金或到期」與「一年以上」兩組。下面這些科目各屬於流動還是非流動？
prompt.en: Moonlight Books’ balance sheet splits its accounts into those that turn into cash or fall due within a year and those that take longer. Is each of these accounts current or non-current?

explanation.zh-TW: 分流動與非流動看的是時間：現金本來就是現金，應收帳款幾個月內會收到，存貨準備在一年內賣掉，所以是{{term:tm_k52yxb68}}；機器設備要用好幾年，是{{term:tm_93mhtb4s}}。應付帳款和短期借款一年內要付，是{{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}；長期借款一年後才到期，是{{term:tm_adqjyfqg}}。
explanation.en: Current or non-current is a question of time: cash is already cash, receivables will be collected within months and inventories are meant to be sold within a year, so they are {{term:tm_k52yxb68}}; machinery will be used for years, so it belongs to {{term:tm_93mhtb4s}}. Trade payables and short-term borrowings fall due within a year, so they are {{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}; long-term borrowings fall due later, so they are {{term:tm_adqjyfqg}}.
